title: A xianxia sect scene: the ward cracks, a rival envoy demands qi stones, and a wounded stranger arrives

lines.text: 清晨,山门外的云雾还没散。
lines.ref: At dawn, the mist outside the mountain gate had not yet cleared.

lines.speaker: 曾若水
lines.text: 云舟,你可算回来了。灵石带够了吗?
lines.ref: Yunzhou, you're finally back. Did you bring enough qi stones?

lines.speaker: 单云舟
lines.text: 带了三袋,都是后山最好的。
lines.ref: Three bags, all the best from the back mountain.

lines.speaker: 曾若水
lines.text: 结界昨夜又裂了一道缝,覃长老一夜没睡。
lines.ref: The ward cracked again last night. Elder Qin hasn't slept all night.

lines.text: 话音未落,万俟(mòqí)靖从山下飞奔上来。
lines.ref: Before the words had faded, Moqi Jing came running up from below.

lines.text: 他喘着气说,山脚的路边倒着一个年轻女
lines.ref: Panting, he said a young woman lay collapsed by the road at the foot of the mountain.

lines.speaker: 覃长老
lines.text: 快抬上来。若水,去取疗伤的丹药。
lines.ref: Bring her up at once. Ruoshui, fetch the healing pills.

lines.text: 万俟靖背着昏迷的女子冲进大殿,腰间的铁牌刻着:仇(qiú)霜。
lines.ref: Moqi Jing carried the unconscious woman into the hall at a run. The iron tag at her waist read: Qiu Shuang.

lines.speaker: 乐川
lines.text: 伤不重,就是灵力耗尽了。喂一颗回灵丹就行。
lines.ref: She isn't badly hurt, just drained of spiritual energy. One restoring pill will do.

lines.speaker: 单云舟
lines.text: 曾师姐,覃长老叫你去结界那边,这里有我和万俟师兄。
lines.ref: Zeng Shijie, Elder Qin wants you at the ward. Senior Brother Moqi and I are here.

lines.speaker: 曾若水
lines.text: 好。仇姑娘醒了,立刻来叫我。
lines.ref: Okay. The moment Miss Qiu wakes, come get me.

lines.text: 万俟靖挠了挠头,又转身跑向山脚。
lines.ref: Moqi Jing scratched his head and ran back down toward the foot of the mountain.

lines.text: 解玄立在殿门口,剑未出鞘,灯火却暗了一瞬。
lines.ref: Xie Xuan stood in the doorway. The sword was still sheathed, yet the lamps dimmed for a moment.

lines.speaker: 解玄
lines.text: 覃长老,别来无恙。我奉阁主之命,来取三成灵石。
lines.ref: Elder Qin, I trust you are well. By my master's order, I have come for three-tenths of the qi stones.

lines.speaker: 覃长老
lines.text: 三成?灵石是宗门辛苦攒下的,几时轮到外人来取?
lines.ref: Three-tenths? Those qi stones were saved through the sect's hard work. Since when do outsiders come to take them?

lines.speaker: 解玄
lines.text: 结界都裂了,灵石放在你们手里不安全。三日后,我再来。
lines.ref: The ward is already cracked, and the qi stones aren't safe in your hands. I'll be back in three days.

lines.text: 解玄冷笑一声,转身便走,头也不囬。
lines.ref: Xie Xuan gave a cold laugh and strode off without looking back.

lines.speaker: 曾若水
lines.text: 说三日就是三日,从不食言。
lines.ref: Three days means three days. She never goes back on her word.

lines.text: 覃长老捋着胡须,望了望榻上昏睡的仇霜。
lines.ref: Elder Qin stroked his beard and glanced at Qiu Shuang, asleep on the couch.

lines.speaker: 单云舟
lines.text: 长老,让我去守结界吧。仇姑娘有乐川照看,我走得开。
lines.ref: Elder, let me guard the ward. Yue Chuan is looking after Miss Qiu, so I can be spared.

lines.text: 终于,点了点头,从袖中取出一枚玉符。
lines.ref: At last, he nodded and took a jade talisman from his sleeve.

lines.speaker: 覃长老
lines.text: 这是阵眼令。守住了它,才算守住你的道。
lines.ref: This is the array-eye token. Hold it, and you hold your Dao.

lines.text: 乐川把药囊塞进云舟怀里,又低声叮嘱了几句。
lines.ref: Yue Chuan stuffed a medicine pouch into Yunzhou's arms and murmured a few more reminders.

lines.text: 山门口,万俟靖递来一件蓑衣。
lines.ref: At the gate, Moqi Jing handed over a rain cape.

lines.speaker: 单云舟
lines.text: 多谢万俟师兄。仇姑娘醒了,替我道声谢。
lines.ref: Thanks, Senior Brother Moqi. When Miss Qiu wakes, thank her for me.

lines.text: 单云舟点点头,把阵眼令贴身收好。
lines.ref: Shan Yunzhou nodded and tucked the array-eye token safely away.

lines.text: 殿里,仇霜缓缓睁开了眼睛。
lines.ref: Inside the hall, Qiu Shuang slowly opened her eyes.

lines.speaker: 乐川
lines.text: 醒了就好。你昏了一整天,别乱动 ▼
lines.ref: Good, you're awake. You were out for a whole day, so don't move around.

lines.text: 仇霜挣扎着坐起身,望向窗外裂开的天幕。
lines.ref: Qiu Shuang struggled upright and gazed at the cracked sky outside the window.

lines.text: 无人察觉,袖中的信笺上,盖着解玄的印。
lines.ref: No one noticed that the letter in her sleeve bore Xie Xuan's seal.

bad_sub: She never goes back on her word
He never goes back on his word
